scientific_question: When the same train-only student-recovery experience is supplied through different carriers, does held-out WebShop behavior improve through text memory, parametric SD-LoRA, or neither?
hypothesis: H1.14 produced a valid recovery corpus but no qualified successful demonstrations. A matched carrier diagnostic can still distinguish whether recovery experience is usable by the base agent and whether the failure is specific to parametric internalization.

experience_source.role: one shared train-only recovery corpus for TEXT-MEMORY and PARAMETRIC
experience_source.source_teacher_boundary: H1.14 Qwen2.5-14B teacher labels train-only recovery states only; no teacher output or held-out outcome enters evaluation

training_panel.task_role: train-only experience source; disjoint from all evaluation tasks

evaluation_panel.task_role: held-out evaluation only; no outcome or trace flows back into the experience corpus
evaluation_panel.cell_design: 3 arms x 2 held-out partitions = 6 cells; one independent UUID-bound cell per authorized GPU

carrier_contract.BASE: frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with no experience and no adapter
carrier_contract.TEXT-MEMORY: frozen base with deterministic top-1 lexical retrieval from the shared train-only recovery corpus injected at every evaluation step
carrier_contract.PARAMETRIC: frozen base reloaded with the official OpenEvo SD-LoRA artifact trained on the shared recovery corpus

text_memory.retrieval: token-set cosine similarity over normalized state-prompt tokens; ties break by event_id
text_memory.prompt_injection: fixed [experience] block after the canonical compact-v2 WebShop prompt and before generation
text_memory.evaluation_access: train-only memory bank only; no evaluation trace, goal, score, or outcome is written to the bank

frozen_variables.parser_retry: frozen ParserSafeRetryBackend contract; retries are runtime diagnostics and never change the denominator rule
frozen_variables.evaluation: no teacher, no post-test prompt changes, no action post-processing, no evaluation-to-training feedback

diagnostic_metrics: retrieved action validity against current available actions
parametric training loss and artifact reload identity

required: training task IDs disjoint from evaluation task IDs
evaluation seeds disjoint from acquisition seeds
text memory contains only the frozen H1.14 train-only corpus
parametric dataset digest equals the shared carrier corpus digest
all artifacts carry task, seed, carrier, model, and upstream provenance
contamination_check.fail_closed: any identity, carrier, task, seed, or memory-boundary mismatch invalidates the affected cell and excludes it from the scientific denominator

resource_budget.expected_gpu_hours: one bounded four-step adapter fit plus 96 evaluation attempts across six cells
resource_budget.gpu_policy: use only genuinely idle authorized UUIDs; do not duplicate cells or occupy GPUs without a preregistered information-bearing cell

stop_rule: one bounded carrier diagnostic; no rank/LR/epoch sweep, no additional teacher seeds, no prompt rescue, no repeated evaluation seeds

branch_rule.text_positive_parametric_negative: classify as parametric internalization bottleneck; preregister one localized parametric objective/mechanism only after reconciliation
branch_rule.both_negative: classify as base-agent/interface/experience-usability bottleneck; stop adapter micro-variants and revisit the frozen interface under a new question
branch_rule.parametric_positive: replicate on new tasks/seeds before Q3 opens; do not interpret a single panel as general learning
branch_rule.task_specific: retain heterogeneity evidence and do not promote a global carrier claim
branch_rule.invalid: repair only the failed runtime/provenance contract without changing carrier semantics or denominator

upstream_audit.decision: retain the pinned runtime; use official SD-LoRA as the parametric carrier and isolate text memory without importing unrelated agent-system evolution

claim_boundary: Carrier diagnosis only; no Q3 opening, H2, D0, retention/transfer, or SEED claim before independent confirmation and the later official-baseline gate

cell_summary.PARAMETRIC-B: 8/16 valid, 0 qualified positives; tasks 4170 and 6602 parser-invalid

result.code_boundary: BASE/TEXT-MEMORY used 22ff71e; PARAMETRIC used 69c5e9c, a path-normalization repair required to load the adapter. Treat the carrier result as diagnostic evidence, not a strict same-SHA causal comparison.
result.next: Do not open Q3/H2/D0 or sweep. Repair/protocol-register a strict same-code carrier confirmation only if a new question permits fresh seeds; otherwise revisit parser validity/interface bottleneck.
